text:
michael: product confirmed sunset date for v1 endpoints: 2026-07-15. we need a concise migration cheatsheet + 2-line snippets for Go and Ruby. also add a one-paragraph support reply template.
tanya: ok. i'll draft the cheatsheet with bullet steps and a tiny rollback snippet. aim for >1 PR but keep it easy to skim.
jose: snippet requests: include auth header examples and a short test assertion for response schema. i can add the test in Go.
amy: i'll handle the support reply template and make sure it mentions known error codes and suggested quick fixes (invalid_model -> check model param; unauthorized -> rotate key).
docs-bot: created staging preview with initial cheatsheet draft: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/migrations/sunset-v1-cheatsheet
tanya: draft link looks good. added Ruby example for Auth: ```ruby
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate')
req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri)
req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY']}"
req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
req.body = {model: 'redwood/gpt-4-mini', input: 'Hello'}.to_json
res = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) { |http| http.request(req) }
puts res.code
```
jose: added tiny Go unit test snippet asserting POST to /v2/generate returns 200 for smoke check. pushed to PR branch.
amy: support template: "Hi <customer>, the v1 endpoints are being retired. Please update to v2 (use model param on /v2/generate). If you see invalid_model, confirm the model name and SDK version. If you need help, we can run a short migration session." i'll upload to internal KB.
michael: plan: docs merge by 2026-06-01, comms draft by 2026-06-05, announce 2026-06-15 with 30 days' notice. tanya/jose, please request reviews.
